name: reference.blacklist.bank

list.description: List native bank blacklist settings, selecting the latest configuration per bank and Swift code.

parameters.name: bank-id
parameters.description: Exact local bankId match; repeated values OR, dimensions AND. Never sent to the backend.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Exact local status match; repeated values OR, dimensions AND. Never sent to the backend.

summary: Latest bank blacklist settings per native bank and Swift code.
purpose: Inspect maintained bank blacklist configurations without inferring enforcement from status.

fields.name: bankSwiftCode
fields.meaning: Native Swift code; an observed empty string is preserved.

fields.name: status
fields.meaning: Native configuration status; enforcement is not inferred.

fields.name: gmtModified
fields.meaning: Native modification epoch milliseconds, first selection criterion.

fields.name: gmtCreate
fields.meaning: Native creation epoch milliseconds, breaking modification ties.

identity_description: Native (bankId, bankSwiftCode); empty native Swift is preserved as a literal key component.
limitations: Fixed qualified query context GUAPW3SG, timezone GMT+08, currentArea 2; inquiry-only GET with JSON-string bankFilterConfigQuery.

Select greatest (gmtModified, gmtCreate) per (bankId, bankSwiftCode), preserving the full selected native record and first-key order. Identical ties collapse; divergent fully tied configurations are unresolved.
Native total counts raw row occurrences, independently from selected configurations. Source coverage requires stable overlaps and an empty exact-total terminal response.
Exact local bank-id/status filters apply after selection; all statuses are retained by default. No Get or bank-directory joins.

sync.evidence: Native (bankId, bankSwiftCode); empty native Swift is preserved as a literal key component. Complete acquisition uses the declared native List collector and its scope/completeness evidence.
